text:
elaine_sales (Sales): Heads-up: ModuPrime wants a 4-week POC. They've got a custom build 'orca-micro-12b-q8b-fused' exported from their trainer. Main asks: estimate reserved pricing for ~1.2M tokens/mo, persistent per-session KV cache support, Dedicated on A100, and Private VPC + bring-your-own-KMS. cc @ryan_ml @jaz_ops @indra_sec

ryan_ml (Eng-ML): Quick clarifying q: does their export include any fused attention or custom CUDA kernels? If yes we'll need the original export config and maybe a rebuild. Also what's their expected p95 latency?

elaine_sales (Sales): They want p95 <= 350ms for short form answers. Most prompts ~30t, responses ~180t. They said the export was from a custom pipeline that did some operator fusion.

ryan_ml (Eng-ML): Operator fusion is a red flag for runtime compatibility. If it's fused into a custom op we'll need either: 1) the unfused checkpoint, or 2) their fused op source and licensable binaries. Otherwise we fallback to a compatible quant path which may increase mem/latency.

jaz_ops (Solutions): For Dedicated A100 pool, ballpark reserved pricing + effective token unit depends on utilization and batching. For a 12B q8b variant with decent batch hit rate I'd estimate between $0.006 and $0.013 per 1k tokens in our reserved model (higher if KV miss rate is low). I'll refine once Eng-ML reports expected throughput.

indra_sec (Security): BYO-KMS is supported. We'll need their KMS key ARN and an IAM policy template. Also send them our security questionnaire and KMS integration checklist. If they plan to ingest regulated data we need the compliance flag.

ryan_ml (Eng-ML): Given 1.2M tokens/mo and p95 350ms at 45 peak concurrency (assume bursty), rough perf plan: enable continuous batching, prefix-only KV cache (session persistent), int8 / q8b where possible. Example smoke config: 
```
model: orca-micro-12b-q8b-fused
precision: q8b
hardware: a100-80gb
batching:
  max_tokens_per_batch: 8192
  latency_target_ms: 300
kv_cache: prefix_session_persistent
sequence_max: 2048
```

ryan_ml (Eng-ML): Note: fused export may contain custom attention kernels and RMSNorm fused with bias; that can break our standard kernel selection. If they cannot provide unfused checkpoint, plan for a compatibility test and possibly a custom runtime build. That could add ~3-5 business days to POC setup.

elaine_sales (Sales): Got it. I'll ask ModuPrime for both the unfused checkpoint and a short sample of 40 prompts (diverse lengths).

infra-bot: Ticket POC-3178 created: "moduprime-staging-request" assigned to eng-ml and eng-infra. Estimated setup 72h. :wrench:

jaz_ops (Solutions): Cost sensitivity note: KV cache hit rate is huge here. If session prefix caching hits 70% we can amortize compute and drop effective cost ~20-30% vs no cache. Ask them if they expect many repeated prefixes.

indra_sec (Security): Also need their retention window expectation and whether they require logs forwarded to their SIEM. For BYO-KMS we need key rotation policy and whether they want us to hold any key material (we don't by default).

elaine_sales (Sales): They're fine with 90-day retention and will forward logs. No PHI. I'll send questionnaire and KMS ARN.

ryan_ml (Eng-ML): For validation I need: checkpoint or model wheel, 40-60 prompts, concurrency profile (burst shape), and baseline examples to check quality regression. I'll run perf + small eval and report any kernel/op fallbacks.

jaz_ops (Solutions): Once perf numbers come back I'll produce a draft reserved quote: pool size recommendation, monthly reserved fee, and token-adjusted effective rate. Expect a draft within 48h after eng-ml results.

elaine_sales (Sales): Perfect. I'll update ModuPrime and push them to share artifacts asap.

indra_sec (Security): If they want faster security review, have them mark the questionnaire as high priority and provide SOC2 evidence. Normal turnaround 2-3 business days.

ryan_ml (Eng-ML): One last ask: if their export contains custom fused kernels, also ask for the training repo commit hash and the CUDA/cuDNN versions used to build the fused ops. That helps us reproduce when needed.

elaine_sales (Sales): Will do. I'll post their answers here when I have them. :rocket:
